item.title: Run a Performance Test
item.description:
Operator mode shows a live picture of your clusters. A performance test adds the missing signal: how a service responds under load. You select a Service or Ingress on the canvas, Kanvas seeds a test from it, and Meshery runs the load and keeps the result as a reusable performance profile.

Before you start 🔗

  • Operator mode on a Meshery you run. The hosted kanvas.new site does not offer Operator mode.
  • A target Meshery Server can reach. Meshery Server generates the load, not your browser and not the cluster. The address you test must be routable from wherever Meshery Server runs. A ClusterIP address is reachable from inside the cluster only.
  • Performance permissions. The form needs View performance profiles to appear, and the Run Test button needs Run test. See Permissions by Role.

Start a test 🔗

The action is named Initiate Performance Test and is offered on Service and Ingress resources only, the kinds that expose an endpoint. It is not offered on pods, deployments, or any other kind. Right-click the resource, or select it and use the action in the header of the Details panel.

item.title: Render Modes
item.description:
Render mode sets how much detail Kanvas draws for a design. It works as a fidelity dial for your current session, not a property of the design. Switching modes never changes components, relationships, configuration, or layers, and the mode is not saved with the design. Every session starts in Full unless the URL sets a different mode. The switcher appears in the Options dialog and in the Designer toolbar.

What each mode trades away 🔗

Kanvas has four render modes. Each of the first three gives up something the mode above it draws.

item.title: URL Parameters
item.description:
Kanvas reads its starting state from the query string of its address. A link can open a specific design, open Operator on a view, choose how much detail the canvas draws, and restore a zoom and pan position. The links produced by the Share dialog and by Copy Link are built from these parameters.

Append parameters to the Kanvas route of the Meshery you are using. On the hosted app that route is https://kanvas.new/extension/meshmap; on the Meshery Playground or a self-hosted Meshery it is /extension/meshmap on that host.

item.title: Auto-pan on Drag
item.description:
Auto-pan on Drag scrolls the canvas for you while you drag a component toward the edge of the view. Without it, moving a component to a part of the design that is off screen takes a drag, a manual pan, and another drag. With it, one continuous drag carries the component there.

Auto-pan is off by default. You turn it on as a personal setting, and Kanvas still switches it off while a design is too large for the current render mode.

item.title: Performance Limits
item.description: Kanvas draws a design on a canvas and redraws it on every pan, zoom and edit. The cost grows with the number of components and relationships and with how much detail each one carries. Kanvas controls that cost in four ways: the render mode you choose, gates that turn expensive features off past a design size or below a zoom level, Adaptive mode, which changes the render mode for you, and a small number of enforced limits.
